source_text: That's odd.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.That's odd.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.That's odd."

translation: To dziwne.

source_text: I finished at the church.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I finished at the church.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I finished at the church."

translation: Skończyłem w kościele.

source_text: Don’t rush your work, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOpNo1.Don’t rush your work, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOpNo1.Don’t rush your work, 1Hero."

translation: Nie spiesz się, 1Hero.

source_text: We’re all good, it was just a cat.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We’re all good, it was just a cat.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We’re all good, it was just a cat."

translation: Wszystko w porządku, to był tylko kot.

source_text: You’ve got a lot to learn.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.You’ve got a lot to learn.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.You’ve got a lot to learn."

translation: Wiele jeszcze musisz się nauczyć.

source_text: You knew that case was bogus. What’s the surprise?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.You knew that case was bogus. What’s the surprise?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.You knew that case was bogus. What’s the surprise?"

translation: Wiedziałeś, że ta sprawa była lipna. Co cię dziwi?

source_text: Keep your damn mouth shut.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOpNo1.Keep your damn mouth shut.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOpNo1.Keep your damn mouth shut."

translation: Trzymaj, do cholery, język za zębami.

source_text: Do I have to go back to the office?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Do I have to go back to the office?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Do I have to go back to the office?"

translation: Muszę wracać do biura?

source_text: Follow my lead, and just listen.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Follow my lead, and just listen.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Follow my lead, and just listen."

translation: Rób, co mówię, i po prostu słuchaj.

source_text: So, that’s it?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.So, that’s it?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.So, that’s it?"

translation: To już wszystko?

source_text: Go find the maid, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Go find the maid, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Go find the maid, 1Hero."

translation: Znajdź pokojówkę, 1Hero.

source_text: But I thought…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.But I thought…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.But I thought…"

translation: Ale myślałem…

source_text: I want to know more about this Madalyn woman.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.I want to know more about this Madalyn woman.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.I want to know more about this Madalyn woman."

translation: Chcę dowiedzieć się więcej o tej Madalyn.

source_text: Do you remember the Saint Dame University case?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Do you remember the Saint Dame University case?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Do you remember the Saint Dame University case?"

translation: Pamiętasz sprawę z Uniwersytetu Saint Dame?

source_text: Uhh… Refresh me.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Uhh… Refresh me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Uhh… Refresh me."

translation: Eee… Przypomnij mi.

source_text: Madalyn Rose was the mother superior at Saint Dame Church.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Madalyn Rose was the mother superior at Saint Dame Church.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Madalyn Rose was the mother superior at Saint Dame Church."

translation: Madalyn Rose była matką przełożoną w kościele Saint Dame.

source_text: Wait… The one who kidnapped those girls?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Wait… The one who kidnapped those girls?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Wait… The one who kidnapped those girls?"

translation: Chwila… Tą, która porwała tamte dziewczyny?

source_text: And then murdered a priest.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.And then murdered a priest.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.And then murdered a priest."

translation: A potem zamordowała księdza.

source_text: You think it’s her?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.You think it’s her?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.You think it’s her?"

translation: Myślisz, że to ona?

source_text: There’s only one way to find out.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.There’s only one way to find out.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.There’s only one way to find out."

translation: Jest tylko jeden sposób, żeby się przekonać.

source_text: I’ll find the maid.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll find the maid.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll find the maid."

translation: Znajdę pokojówkę.

source_text: Do you remember her name?

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Do you remember her name?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.Do you remember her name?"

translation: Pamiętasz jej imię?

source_text: Erica Abraham… Lives in the apartments downtown.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Erica Abraham… Lives in the apartments downtown.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Erica Abraham… Lives in the apartments downtown."

translation: Erica Abraham… Mieszka w apartamentach w centrum.

source_text: So, you did listen.

structure.raw_value: MeFrOp.So, you did listen.
structure.script_literal: "MeFrOp.So, you did listen."

translation: Czyli jednak słuchałeś.

source_text: I’ll find her and bring her in for questioning.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll find her and bring her in for questioning.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll find her and bring her in for questioning."

translation: Znajdę ją i sprowadzę na przesłuchanie.

source_text: I’ll meet you back at the office.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.I’ll meet you back at the office.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.I’ll meet you back at the office."

translation: Spotkamy się w biurze.

source_text: I knew there was more to this case.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp^.I knew there was more to this case.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp^.I knew there was more to this case."

translation: Wiedziałem, że w tej sprawie jest coś więcej.

source_text: Too bad Miss Bhatt doesn’t listen to me.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe^.Too bad Miss Bhatt doesn’t listen to me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe^.Too bad Miss Bhatt doesn’t listen to me."

translation: Szkoda, że panna Bhatt mnie nie słucha.

source_text: I better not let her down. I need to find Erica.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp^.I better not let her down. I need to find Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp^.I better not let her down. I need to find Erica."

translation: Nie mogę jej zawieść. Muszę znaleźć Ericę.

source_text: I appreciate your help, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.I appreciate your help, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.I appreciate your help, 1Hero."

translation: Dziękuję za pomoc, 1Hero.

source_text: We’ll talk about this later, Paul.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We’ll talk about this later, Paul.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We’ll talk about this later, Paul."

translation: Porozmawiamy o tym później, Paul.

source_text: He wasn’t the only one. He’s distracting us.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.He wasn’t the only one. He’s distracting us.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.He wasn’t the only one. He’s distracting us."

translation: Nie tylko on. Chce nas odciągnąć od sprawy.

source_text: I know. I’ll see what I can find.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I know. I’ll see what I can find.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I know. I’ll see what I can find."

translation: Wiem. Sprawdzę, co uda mi się znaleźć.

source_text: They’re with me.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.They’re with me.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.They’re with me."

translation: Są ze mną.

source_text: Welcome back, 1Hero. What brings you here?

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.Welcome back, 1Hero. What brings you here?
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.Welcome back, 1Hero. What brings you here?"

translation: Witaj ponownie, 1Hero. Co cię sprowadza?

source_text: I’ve been working on your case, and I’ve made some connections with people who know Duncan Helmer.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ve been working on your case, and I’ve made some connections with people who know Duncan Helmer.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ve been working on your case, and I’ve made some connections with people who know Duncan Helmer."

translation: Pracowałem nad twoją sprawą i nawiązałem kontakt z ludźmi, którzy znają Duncana Helmera.

source_text: Duncan Helmer?

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.Duncan Helmer?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.Duncan Helmer?"

translation: Duncan Helmer?

source_text: He’s one of the leaders of the Eclipse Guild. He would know who stole your father’s amulets.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.He’s one of the leaders of the Eclipse Guild. He would know who stole your father’s amulets.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.He’s one of the leaders of the Eclipse Guild. He would know who stole your father’s amulets."

translation: Jest jednym z przywódców Gildii Eclipse. Może wiedzieć, kto ukradł amulety twojego ojca.

source_text: Come, 1Hero. Let us speak inside.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.Come, 1Hero. Let us speak inside.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.Come, 1Hero. Let us speak inside."

translation: Chodź, 1Hero. Porozmawiajmy w środku.

source_text: What’s going on? What do you want to show me?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What’s going on? What do you want to show me?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What’s going on? What do you want to show me?"

translation: Co się dzieje? Co chcesz mi pokazać?

source_text: There’s a storage bunker under our feet.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.There’s a storage bunker under our feet.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.There’s a storage bunker under our feet."

translation: Pod nami znajduje się schron magazynowy.

source_text: If what I suspect is true, then Charles could very well have been a Guild leader and Lillian may be continuing the family business.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.If what I suspect is true, then Charles could very well have been a Guild leader and Lillian may be continuing the family business.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.If what I suspect is true, then Charles could very well have been a Guild leader and Lillian may be continuing the family business."

translation: Jeśli moje podejrzenia są słuszne, Charles mógł być przywódcą Gildii, a Lillian może kontynuować rodzinny interes.

source_text: So, how do we get to the bunker?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.So, how do we get to the bunker?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.So, how do we get to the bunker?"

translation: Więc jak dostać się do schronu?

source_text: I’ve not figured that out yet. I was hoping to see something obvious.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.I’ve not figured that out yet. I was hoping to see something obvious.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.I’ve not figured that out yet. I was hoping to see something obvious."

translation: Jeszcze tego nie ustaliłem. Liczyłem, że zauważę coś oczywistego.

source_text: Bobby? What’s going on?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Bobby? What’s going on?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Bobby? What’s going on?"

translation: Bobby? Co się dzieje?

source_text: We’re reducing the police presence here. Commissioner’s orders.

structure.raw_value: BoBaEx.We’re reducing the police presence here. Commissioner’s orders.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaEx.We’re reducing the police presence here. Commissioner’s orders."

translation: Ograniczamy tu obecność policji. Rozkaz komisarz.

source_text: Is Lillian aware?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Is Lillian aware?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Is Lillian aware?"

translation: Lillian o tym wie?

source_text: We can’t find the girl.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.We can’t find the girl.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.We can’t find the girl."

translation: Nie możemy znaleźć dziewczyny.

source_text: Is anyone looking for her?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Is anyone looking for her?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Is anyone looking for her?"

translation: Ktoś jej szuka?

source_text: We’re not babysitters, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.We’re not babysitters, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.We’re not babysitters, 1Hero."

translation: Nie jesteśmy niańkami, 1Hero.

source_text: If you’re so concerned, then you find her.

structure.raw_value: BaFlEx.If you’re so concerned, then you find her.
structure.script_literal: "BaFlEx.If you’re so concerned, then you find her."

translation: Jeśli tak się martwisz, sam ją znajdź.

source_text: Sorry, ma’am. I said no interviews.

structure.raw_value: ObBaOp^.Sorry, ma’am. I said no interviews.
structure.script_literal: "ObBaOp^.Sorry, ma’am. I said no interviews."

translation: Przykro mi, proszę pani. Mówiłam, że nie udzielamy wywiadów.

source_text: Do you know who I am?

structure.raw_value: KiAnOp.Do you know who I am?
structure.script_literal: "KiAnOp.Do you know who I am?"

translation: Wie pani, kim jestem?

source_text: Please leave the premises.

structure.raw_value: ObBaEx^.Please leave the premises.
structure.script_literal: "ObBaEx^.Please leave the premises."

translation: Proszę opuścić teren.

source_text: 1Hero! Thank God you’re here.

structure.raw_value: KiShOp.1Hero! Thank God you’re here.
structure.script_literal: "KiShOp.1Hero! Thank God you’re here."

translation: 1Hero! Dzięki Bogu, że jesteś.

source_text: Kimberly? What are you doing here?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Kimberly? What are you doing here?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Kimberly? What are you doing here?"

translation: Kimberly? Co tu robisz?

source_text: Trying to film a segment for Channel 4 Tonight, but these knuckleheads won't give me an interview.

structure.raw_value: KiAnEx.Trying to film a segment for Channel 4 Tonight, but these knuckleheads won't give me an interview.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnEx.Trying to film a segment for Channel 4 Tonight, but these knuckleheads won't give me an interview."

translation: Próbuję nagrać materiał dla „Channel 4 Tonight”, ale ci durnie nie chcą udzielić mi wywiadu.

source_text: God dammit! Why is she still here?

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp^.God dammit! Why is she still here?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp^.God dammit! Why is she still here?"

translation: Niech to szlag! Czemu ona wciąż tu jest?

source_text: What’s going on here at the Wilkes’ mansion? Care to comment?

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.What’s going on here at the Wilkes’ mansion? Care to comment?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.What’s going on here at the Wilkes’ mansion? Care to comment?"

translation: Co się dzieje w rezydencji Wilkesów? Chcecie to skomentować?

source_text: No comments! Now leave.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe^.No comments! Now leave.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe^.No comments! Now leave."

translation: Bez komentarza! A teraz proszę odejść.

source_text: Was Charles Wilkes a Guild leader? Has the Guild been operating out of North Santiva?

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Was Charles Wilkes a Guild leader? Has the Guild been operating out of North Santiva?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Was Charles Wilkes a Guild leader? Has the Guild been operating out of North Santiva?"

translation: Czy Charles Wilkes był przywódcą Gildii? Czy Gildia działała z North Santiva?

source_text: Get her out of here, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp^.Get her out of here, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp^.Get her out of here, 1Hero."

translation: Zabierz ją stąd, 1Hero.

source_text: Kimberly… We can’t really talk about what’s going on here.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Kimberly… We can’t really talk about what’s going on here.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Kimberly… We can’t really talk about what’s going on here."

translation: Kimberly… Nie możemy rozmawiać o tym, co tu się dzieje.

source_text: 1Hero… I thought you’d be more helpful.

structure.raw_value: KiAnDe.1Hero… I thought you’d be more helpful.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnDe.1Hero… I thought you’d be more helpful."

translation: 1Hero… Myślałam, że będziesz bardziej pomocny.

source_text: Look… The daughter of Charles is in danger from thieves trying to take advantage of the lack of security.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Look… The daughter of Charles is in danger from thieves trying to take advantage of the lack of security.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Look… The daughter of Charles is in danger from thieves trying to take advantage of the lack of security."

translation: Słuchaj… Córce Charlesa grożą złodzieje, którzy chcą wykorzystać brak ochrony.

source_text: You can’t fool me, 1Hero. I know more than you think.

structure.raw_value: KiAnDe.You can’t fool me, 1Hero. I know more than you think.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnDe.You can’t fool me, 1Hero. I know more than you think."

translation: Nie oszukasz mnie, 1Hero. Wiem więcej, niż myślisz.

source_text: If you don’t leave, you’re under arrest.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx^.If you don’t leave, you’re under arrest.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx^.If you don’t leave, you’re under arrest."

translation: Jeśli nie odejdziesz, aresztuję cię.

source_text: Fine. I see how it is. I wonder if the commissioner will share your lack of enthusiasm for informing the people.

structure.raw_value: KiAnOp.Fine. I see how it is. I wonder if the commissioner will share your lack of enthusiasm for informing the people.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnOp.Fine. I see how it is. I wonder if the commissioner will share your lack of enthusiasm for informing the people."

translation: Dobra, rozumiem. Ciekawe, czy komisarz też nie będzie chciała informować ludzi.

source_text: It’s her orders… No interviews.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx^.It’s her orders… No interviews.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx^.It’s her orders… No interviews."

translation: Taki jest jej rozkaz… Żadnych wywiadów.

source_text: Kimura won't be happy that your broad is here filming the mansion.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Kimura won't be happy that your broad is here filming the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Kimura won't be happy that your broad is here filming the mansion."

translation: Kimurze nie spodoba się, że twoja laska nagrywa tu materiał.

source_text: I had no idea she was here.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I had no idea she was here.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I had no idea she was here."

translation: Nie wiedziałem, że tu jest.

source_text: Don’t make my job hard, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Don’t make my job hard, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Don’t make my job hard, 1Hero."

translation: Nie utrudniaj mi pracy, 1Hero.

source_text: No sign of any thieves. But I suspect the lady inside isn’t too happy about our presence.

structure.raw_value: ObBaEx.No sign of any thieves. But I suspect the lady inside isn’t too happy about our presence.
structure.script_literal: "ObBaEx.No sign of any thieves. But I suspect the lady inside isn’t too happy about our presence."

translation: Nie ma śladu złodziei. Ale podejrzewam, że pani w środku nie jest zadowolona z naszej obecności.

source_text: I’m sure she isn’t.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I’m sure she isn’t.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I’m sure she isn’t."

translation: Jestem tego pewien.

source_text: I could probably figure out a way to get inside… But I think I’d rather keep watch right here.

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.I could probably figure out a way to get inside… But I think I’d rather keep watch right here.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.I could probably figure out a way to get inside… But I think I’d rather keep watch right here."

translation: Pewnie znalazłbym sposób, żeby dostać się do środka… Ale chyba wolę pilnować tego miejsca.

source_text: Oh great, another detective. Today just keeps getting better.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.Oh great, another detective. Today just keeps getting better.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.Oh great, another detective. Today just keeps getting better."

translation: No świetnie, kolejny detektyw. Ten dzień robi się coraz lepszy.

source_text: What's that supposed to mean?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe^.What's that supposed to mean?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe^.What's that supposed to mean?"

translation: Co to ma znaczyć?

source_text: I dunno, detective. If you're so smart, you tell me.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.I dunno, detective. If you're so smart, you tell me.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.I dunno, detective. If you're so smart, you tell me."

translation: Nie wiem, detektywie. Skoro jesteś taki mądry, sam mi powiedz.

source_text: Lay off it, Bobby.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Lay off it, Bobby.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Lay off it, Bobby."

translation: Daj spokój, Bobby.

source_text: You ready for another round, tough guy?

structure.raw_value: BoFlDe.You ready for another round, tough guy?
structure.script_literal: "BoFlDe.You ready for another round, tough guy?"

translation: Gotowy na kolejną rundę, twardzielu?

source_text: Sure, handle it with your fists like a couple of Neanderthals.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe^.Sure, handle it with your fists like a couple of Neanderthals.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe^.Sure, handle it with your fists like a couple of Neanderthals."

translation: Jasne, załatwcie to pięściami jak para neandertalczyków.

source_text: Shut it.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Shut it.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Shut it."

translation: Zamknij się.

source_text: You shut it.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You shut it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.You shut it."

translation: Sam się zamknij.

source_text: Children, can we get back to the task at hand?

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp^.Children, can we get back to the task at hand?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp^.Children, can we get back to the task at hand?"

translation: Dzieci, możemy wrócić do tego, co mamy zrobić?

source_text: Shouldn’t you be inside with Lillian? Why are you outside?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Shouldn’t you be inside with Lillian? Why are you outside?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Shouldn’t you be inside with Lillian? Why are you outside? "

translation: Nie powinieneś być w środku z Lillian? Czemu jesteś na zewnątrz?

source_text: The wonderful weather, genius.

structure.raw_value: BoFlDe.The wonderful weather, genius.
structure.script_literal: "BoFlDe.The wonderful weather, genius."

translation: Podziwiamy tę wspaniałą pogodę, geniuszu.

source_text: The door's locked and no one answered.

structure.raw_value: DaBaEx^.The door's locked and no one answered.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaEx^.The door's locked and no one answered."

translation: Drzwi są zamknięte i nikt nie odpowiada.

source_text: That’s strange. Why wouldn’t she answer the door?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That’s strange. Why wouldn’t she answer the door?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.That’s strange. Why wouldn’t she answer the door?"

translation: Dziwne. Czemu nie otwiera?

source_text: You were sent here to warn her, weren't you?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.You were sent here to warn her, weren't you?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.You were sent here to warn her, weren't you?"

translation: Przysłano cię, żeby ją ostrzec, prawda?

source_text: What if she's already in danger?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What if she's already in danger?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What if she's already in danger?"

translation: A jeśli już jest w niebezpieczeństwie?

source_text: Slow down, hotshot. We don't have a warrant or probable cause.

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe^.Slow down, hotshot. We don't have a warrant or probable cause.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe^.Slow down, hotshot. We don't have a warrant or probable cause."

translation: Spokojnie, cwaniaku. Nie mamy nakazu ani uzasadnionego podejrzenia.

source_text: Listen to gramps, Mike Tyson. No warrant.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.Listen to gramps, Mike Tyson. No warrant.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.Listen to gramps, Mike Tyson. No warrant."

translation: Posłuchaj dziadka, Mike’u Tysonie. Nie mamy nakazu.

source_text: Right. Like you've ever cared about a warrant before, Bobby.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Right. Like you've ever cared about a warrant before, Bobby.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Right. Like you've ever cared about a warrant before, Bobby."

translation: Jasne. Jakbyś kiedykolwiek przejmował się nakazem, Bobby.

source_text: What're you trying to say?

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.What're you trying to say?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.What're you trying to say?"

translation: Co próbujesz powiedzieć?

source_text: Are all young men this obtuse these days?

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe^.Are all young men this obtuse these days?
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe^.Are all young men this obtuse these days?"

translation: Czy wszyscy młodzi faceci są teraz tacy tępi?

source_text: While you figure that out, I'm going to try calling Erica.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.While you figure that out, I'm going to try calling Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.While you figure that out, I'm going to try calling Erica."

translation: A wy sobie myślcie, a ja spróbuję zadzwonić do Eriki.

source_text: She’s not picking up…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.She’s not picking up…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.She’s not picking up…"

translation: Nie odbiera…

source_text: Strange. She should be at work right now.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Strange. She should be at work right now.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Strange. She should be at work right now."

translation: Dziwne. Powinna być teraz w pracy.

source_text: Like we said. You deaf or slow, detective?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.Like we said. You deaf or slow, detective?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.Like we said. You deaf or slow, detective?"

translation: Mówiliśmy ci. Jesteś głuchy czy powolny, detektywie?

source_text: Let me try picking the lock if this is so urgent.

structure.raw_value: DaBaOp^.Let me try picking the lock if this is so urgent.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaOp^.Let me try picking the lock if this is so urgent."

translation: Daj mi spróbować otworzyć zamek, skoro to takie pilne.

source_text: This oughta be good.

structure.raw_value: BoHaOp.This oughta be good.
structure.script_literal: "BoHaOp.This oughta be good."

translation: To będzie ciekawe.

source_text: Can you do this any faster, David?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Can you do this any faster, David?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Can you do this any faster, David?"

translation: Możesz się pospieszyć, David?

source_text: Out of the way, old man. I’ll show you how to open a door.

structure.raw_value: BoFlOp.Out of the way, old man. I’ll show you how to open a door.
structure.script_literal: "BoFlOp.Out of the way, old man. I’ll show you how to open a door."

translation: Z drogi, staruszku. Pokażę ci, jak się otwiera drzwi.

source_text: Ha! You showed me, wood-for-brains.

structure.raw_value: DaHaOpNo3^.Ha! You showed me, wood-for-brains.
structure.script_literal: "DaHaOpNo3^.Ha! You showed me, wood-for-brains."

translation: Ha! Ale mi pokazałeś, bezmózgu.

source_text: Ugh.  Keep trying; I’ll look for another way in.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Ugh.  Keep trying; I’ll look for another way in.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Ugh.  Keep trying; I’ll look for another way in."

translation: Ech. Próbuj dalej, a ja poszukam innego wejścia.

source_text: We’re not getting in. Just wait 'til the daughter gets back.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.We’re not getting in. Just wait 'til the daughter gets back.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.We’re not getting in. Just wait 'til the daughter gets back."

translation: Nie wejdziemy do środka. Poczekaj, aż córka wróci.

source_text: See, Bobby? This is why you aren’t a detective.

structure.raw_value: DaFlEx.See, Bobby? This is why you aren’t a detective.
structure.script_literal: "DaFlEx.See, Bobby? This is why you aren’t a detective."

translation: Widzisz, Bobby? Właśnie dlatego nie jesteś detektywem.

source_text: I could have broken in if I tried harder.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.I could have broken in if I tried harder.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.I could have broken in if I tried harder."

translation: Dałbym radę się włamać, gdybym bardziej się postarał.

source_text: Stop arguing. We need to find Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Stop arguing. We need to find Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Stop arguing. We need to find Lillian."

translation: Przestańcie się kłócić. Musimy znaleźć Lillian.

source_text: It looks like a window is open up there. Can I reach it with something?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe<.It looks like a window is open up there. Can I reach it with something?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe<.It looks like a window is open up there. Can I reach it with something?"

translation: Wygląda na to, że tam na górze jest otwarte okno. Czy mogę do niego sięgnąć za pomocą czegoś?

source_text: What the hell is he doing?

structure.raw_value: BoBaOp.What the hell is he doing?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaOp.What the hell is he doing?"

translation: Co on, do cholery, wyprawia?

source_text: You got lucky today.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You got lucky today.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You got lucky today."

translation: Dziś ci się poszczęściło.

source_text: Officers have each other's back. What happened today wasn’t luck.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.Officers have each other's back. What happened today wasn’t luck.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.Officers have each other's back. What happened today wasn’t luck."

translation: Funkcjonariusze zawsze wspierają swoich. To, co się dziś stało, nie było szczęściem.

source_text: I guess the threat is waning…

structure.raw_value: OaBaDe.I guess the threat is waning…
structure.script_literal: "OaBaDe.I guess the threat is waning…"

translation: Chyba zagrożenie słabnie…

source_text: I sure hope I don’t have to take on a gang of thieves by myself.

structure.raw_value: OaWoDe.I sure hope I don’t have to take on a gang of thieves by myself.
structure.script_literal: "OaWoDe.I sure hope I don’t have to take on a gang of thieves by myself."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nie będę musiał sam mierzyć się z bandą złodziei.

source_text: It’s too dark. Whoever is still around the mansion is going to be hard to spot.

structure.raw_value: OaBaEx.It’s too dark. Whoever is still around the mansion is going to be hard to spot.
structure.script_literal: "OaBaEx.It’s too dark. Whoever is still around the mansion is going to be hard to spot."

translation: Jest zbyt ciemno. Trudno będzie dostrzec kogokolwiek kręcącego się przy rezydencji.

source_text: Once night falls, it’ll be hard to see anyone roaming around the mansion.

structure.raw_value: OaBaEx.Once night falls, it’ll be hard to see anyone roaming around the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "OaBaEx.Once night falls, it’ll be hard to see anyone roaming around the mansion."

translation: Kiedy zapadnie noc, trudno będzie dostrzec kogokolwiek kręcącego się wokół rezydencji.

source_text: We’ve got this detective.

structure.raw_value: OaBaEx.We’ve got this detective.
structure.script_literal: "OaBaEx.We’ve got this detective."

translation: Panujemy nad sytuacją, detektywie.

source_text: These cops are a pain in the ass. Did you manage to get inside?

structure.raw_value: TaAnDe.These cops are a pain in the ass. Did you manage to get inside?
structure.script_literal: "TaAnDe.These cops are a pain in the ass. Did you manage to get inside?"

translation: Ci gliniarze są upierdliwi. Udało ci się wejść do środka?

source_text: Yeah… But Lilith escaped with the Toma.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Yeah… But Lilith escaped with the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Yeah… But Lilith escaped with the Toma."

translation: Tak… Ale Lilith uciekła z Tomą.

source_text: Hey. Move aside. I need to speak to Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Hey. Move aside. I need to speak to Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Hey. Move aside. I need to speak to Lillian."

translation: Proszę się odsunąć. Muszę porozmawiać z Lillian.

source_text: No one’s allowed to enter until Officer Rinaldi gets here.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.No one’s allowed to enter until Officer Rinaldi gets here.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.No one’s allowed to enter until Officer Rinaldi gets here."

translation: Nikt nie może wejść, dopóki nie przyjedzie funkcjonariusz Rinaldi.

source_text: What are you talking about? I need to get inside now.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.What are you talking about? I need to get inside now.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.What are you talking about? I need to get inside now."

translation: O czym ty mówisz? Muszę natychmiast wejść do środka.

source_text: The girl isn’t here.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.The girl isn’t here.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.The girl isn’t here."

translation: Dziewczyny tu nie ma.

source_text: I have no clue. Get out of here.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.I have no clue. Get out of here.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.I have no clue. Get out of here."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia. Wynoś się stąd.

source_text: How long will it be before Bobby gets here?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.How long will it be before Bobby gets here?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.How long will it be before Bobby gets here?"

translation: Kiedy przyjedzie Bobby?

source_text: Not long. He’s on his way.

structure.raw_value: OaBaDe.Not long. He’s on his way.
structure.script_literal: "OaBaDe.Not long. He’s on his way."

translation: Niedługo. Już jedzie.

source_text: Hey! You’re not allowed here anymore.

structure.raw_value: OcAnOp.Hey! You’re not allowed here anymore.
structure.script_literal: "OcAnOp.Hey! You’re not allowed here anymore."

translation: Hej! Nie wolno ci już tu wchodzić.

source_text: I need to get through. I need to speak to the commissioner.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I need to get through. I need to speak to the commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I need to get through. I need to speak to the commissioner."

translation: Muszę przejść. Muszę porozmawiać z komisarz.

source_text: Damn! It’s raining cats and dogs.

structure.raw_value: BrWoCl.Damn! It’s raining cats and dogs.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoCl.Damn! It’s raining cats and dogs."

translation: Cholera! Leje jak z cebra.

source_text: Welcome to North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp.Welcome to North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp.Welcome to North Santiva."

translation: Witaj w North Santiva.

source_text: Careful. Let Erica lead the way.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Careful. Let Erica lead the way.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Careful. Let Erica lead the way."

translation: Uważaj. Pozwól Erice prowadzić.

source_text: Where are all the cops?

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp.Where are all the cops?
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp.Where are all the cops?"

translation: Gdzie są wszyscy policjanci?

source_text: Andrea withdrew them. We should be safe.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Andrea withdrew them. We should be safe.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Andrea withdrew them. We should be safe."

translation: Andrea ich wycofała. Powinniśmy być bezpieczni.

source_text: You all have to leave! I have to go back inside.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx.You all have to leave! I have to go back inside.
structure.script_literal: "NeWoEx.You all have to leave! I have to go back inside."

translation: Wszyscy musicie odejść! Muszę wrócić do środka.

source_text: Duncan doesn’t know you’re a mole?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Duncan doesn’t know you’re a mole?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Duncan doesn’t know you’re a mole?"

translation: Duncan nie wie, że jesteś wtyczką?

source_text: It’s complicated, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx.It’s complicated, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "NeWoEx.It’s complicated, 1Hero."

translation: To skomplikowane, 1Hero.

source_text: I thought you were going to be let go. How much longer are you going to be doing this?

structure.raw_value: TaAnOp^.I thought you were going to be let go. How much longer are you going to be doing this?
structure.script_literal: "TaAnOp^.I thought you were going to be let go. How much longer are you going to be doing this?"

translation: Myślałam, że cię zwolnią. Jak długo jeszcze będziesz to robić?

source_text: She won’t stop, Tasha.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.She won’t stop, Tasha.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.She won’t stop, Tasha."

translation: Nie przestanie, Tasha.

source_text: Hey! Fuck you! When this is over, I’m finished.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Hey! Fuck you! When this is over, I’m finished.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Hey! Fuck you! When this is over, I’m finished."

translation: Hej! Pierdol się! Jak to się skończy, odchodzę.

source_text: We need to kill him. That will put a stop to everything.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx>.We need to kill him. That will put a stop to everything.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx>.We need to kill him. That will put a stop to everything."

translation: Musimy go zabić. To zakończy całą sprawę.

source_text: It’s not going to happen.

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.It’s not going to happen.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.It’s not going to happen."

translation: Nie ma mowy.

source_text: Get out of here before he sees us!

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Get out of here before he sees us!
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Get out of here before he sees us!"

translation: Uciekaj stąd, zanim nas zobaczy!

source_text: Come on. We have to go.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Come on. We have to go.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Come on. We have to go."

translation: Chodźmy. Musimy iść.

source_text: Be careful in there, Nellie.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.Be careful in there, Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.Be careful in there, Nellie."

translation: Uważaj tam, Nellie.

source_text: I can handle myself, Brian.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.I can handle myself, Brian.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.I can handle myself, Brian."

translation: Sama sobie poradzę, Brian.

source_text: Let's go back to the cathedral.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Let's go back to the cathedral.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Let's go back to the cathedral."

translation: Wracajmy do katedry.

source_text: Erica!?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.Erica!?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.Erica!?"

translation: Erica!?

source_text: Looks like Duncan’s guards are not out front…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Looks like Duncan’s guards are not out front…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Looks like Duncan’s guards are not out front…"

translation: Wygląda na to, że strażników Duncana nie ma przed wejściem…

source_text: I better be careful if I go inside.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I better be careful if I go inside.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I better be careful if I go inside."

translation: Lepiej uważać, jeśli wejdę do środka.

source_text: Woah! Step back!

structure.raw_value: ObWoEx.Woah! Step back!
structure.script_literal: "ObWoEx.Woah! Step back!"

translation: O rany! Cofnij się!

source_text: Oh my goodness!

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl^.Oh my goodness!
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl^.Oh my goodness!"

translation: O mój Boże!

source_text: The Guild is in there. But we can’t get in.

structure.raw_value: ObAnEx.The Guild is in there. But we can’t get in.
structure.script_literal: "ObAnEx.The Guild is in there. But we can’t get in."

translation: Gildia jest w środku, ale nie możemy się tam dostać.

source_text: Melissa!

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Melissa!
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1.Melissa!"

translation: Melissa!

source_text: How did they escape?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.How did they escape?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.How did they escape?"

translation: Jak im się udało uciec?

source_text: Should've just killed Duncan.

structure.raw_value: TaAnDe.Should've just killed Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnDe.Should've just killed Duncan."

translation: Trzeba było po prostu zabić Duncana.

source_text: We have to save her…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.We have to save her…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.We have to save her…"

translation: Musimy ją uratować…

source_text: Officers! There is a detective in there!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Officers! There is a detective in there!
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Officers! There is a detective in there!"

translation: Funkcjonariusze! W środku jest detektyw!

source_text: What? How come we didn’t know?

structure.raw_value: OcShCl^.What? How come we didn’t know?
structure.script_literal: "OcShCl^.What? How come we didn’t know?"

translation: Co? Dlaczego o tym nie wiedzieliśmy?

source_text: Nevermind that! I need to get in there!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Nevermind that! I need to get in there!
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Nevermind that! I need to get in there!"

translation: Nieważne! Muszę się tam dostać!

source_text: We’re trying! We can’t just barge in. The doors have been barricaded.

structure.raw_value: ObAnEx.We’re trying! We can’t just barge in. The doors have been barricaded.
structure.script_literal: "ObAnEx.We’re trying! We can’t just barge in. The doors have been barricaded."

translation: Próbujemy! Nie możemy tak po prostu wedrzeć się do środka. Drzwi zabarykadowano.

source_text: Fuck! Go through the back.

structure.raw_value: McMaEx.Fuck! Go through the back.
structure.script_literal: "McMaEx.Fuck! Go through the back."

translation: Cholera! Wejdźcie od tyłu.

source_text: You’re not even supposed to be here, Canmore. Scram.

structure.raw_value: ObAnEx.You’re not even supposed to be here, Canmore. Scram.
structure.script_literal: "ObAnEx.You’re not even supposed to be here, Canmore. Scram."

translation: W ogóle nie powinno cię tu być, Canmore. Zmykaj.

source_text: 1Hero…

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.1Hero…
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.1Hero…"

translation: 1Hero…

source_text: Let's sneak in ourselves.

structure.raw_value: HrFrEx^.Let's sneak in ourselves.
structure.script_literal: "HrFrEx^.Let's sneak in ourselves."

translation: Zakradnijmy się tam sami.

source_text: I was just thinking the same.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I was just thinking the same.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I was just thinking the same."

translation: Właśnie o tym samym pomyślałem.

source_text: Through the church.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Through the church.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Through the church."

translation: Przez kościół.

source_text: Or the creek west of the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Or the creek west of the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Or the creek west of the mansion."

translation: Albo przez strumień na zachód od rezydencji.

source_text: Sounds like we have options.

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp^.Sounds like we have options.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp^.Sounds like we have options."

translation: Wygląda na to, że mamy kilka możliwości.

source_text: I’ll wait… Someone should be here in case they get the front door open.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I’ll wait… Someone should be here in case they get the front door open.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I’ll wait… Someone should be here in case they get the front door open."

translation: Zaczekam… Ktoś powinien tu być, gdyby udało im się otworzyć frontowe drzwi.

source_text: Then I’ll stay here with you.

structure.raw_value: TaBaEx.Then I’ll stay here with you.
structure.script_literal: "TaBaEx.Then I’ll stay here with you."

translation: W takim razie zostanę tu z tobą.

source_text: Don’t draw attention to yourselves.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp^.Don’t draw attention to yourselves.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaOp^.Don’t draw attention to yourselves."

translation: Nie zwracajcie na siebie uwagi.

source_text: Arianna… Are there any powers you have that can help us?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Arianna… Are there any powers you have that can help us?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Arianna… Are there any powers you have that can help us?"

translation: Arianna… Masz jakieś moce, które mogłyby nam pomóc?

source_text: I don’t know. I’ve never been in a human body before.

structure.raw_value: ErWoC^l.I don’t know. I’ve never been in a human body before.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoC^l.I don’t know. I’ve never been in a human body before."

translation: Nie wiem. Nigdy wcześniej nie byłam w ludzkim ciele.

source_text: I know where Diana is. I’ll run ahead and let her know the plan.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.I know where Diana is. I’ll run ahead and let her know the plan.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.I know where Diana is. I’ll run ahead and let her know the plan."

translation: Wiem, gdzie jest Diana. Pobiegnę przodem i powiem jej o planie.

source_text: We’re here to save Melissa and find Lilith… We’re not killing Duncan.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.We’re here to save Melissa and find Lilith… We’re not killing Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.We’re here to save Melissa and find Lilith… We’re not killing Duncan."

translation: Jesteśmy tu, żeby uratować Melissę i znaleźć Lilith… Nie zabijemy Duncana.

source_text: And we’re not sticking around once those cops get inside.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx^.And we’re not sticking around once those cops get inside.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx^.And we’re not sticking around once those cops get inside."

translation: A kiedy policjanci dostaną się do środka, znikamy stąd.

source_text: See you around back.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.See you around back.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.See you around back."

translation: Do zobaczenia z tyłu.

source_text: Which direction should we embark?

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.Which direction should we embark?
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.Which direction should we embark?"

translation: W którą stronę powinniśmy ruszyć?

source_text: I look forward to a showdown with Madalyn… I just hope we can save your friend.

structure.raw_value: TaBaDe.I look forward to a showdown with Madalyn… I just hope we can save your friend.
structure.script_literal: "TaBaDe.I look forward to a showdown with Madalyn… I just hope we can save your friend."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać starcia z Madalyn… Mam tylko nadzieję, że uda nam się uratować twoją przyjaciółkę.

source_text: If the police open the front door, I’ll make my way to the basement.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.If the police open the front door, I’ll make my way to the basement.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.If the police open the front door, I’ll make my way to the basement."

translation: Jeśli policja otworzy frontowe drzwi, zejdę do piwnicy.

source_text: Don’t get caught.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Don’t get caught.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Don’t get caught."

translation: Nie daj się złapać.

source_text: Erica? Are you feeling okay?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Erica? Are you feeling okay?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Erica? Are you feeling okay?"

translation: Erica? Dobrze się czujesz?

source_text: I’m cold.

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp.I’m cold.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp.I’m cold."

translation: Jest mi zimno.

source_text: Not sure why we keep asking her. She’s always cold.

structure.raw_value: BrSaEx.Not sure why we keep asking her. She’s always cold.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaEx.Not sure why we keep asking her. She’s always cold."

translation: Nie wiem, po co wciąż ją pytamy. Zawsze jest jej zimno.
